figurative_meaning_bn: পাখের কলমে দ্রুতলেখার শব্দের ভাবব্যঞ্জক দ্বিত্ব শব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: An onomatopoeic reduplicated word evoking the sound of rapid writing with a quill pen
example_sentences_in_english: Write it down quickly with a scratch-scratch.
He scribbled the letter away in a hurry.
history: Originates from the traditional sound of writing with quill pens in pre-modern Bengali society.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used to describe hasty writing.
